sharedTypeDefinition: cross-species type pairs nearer than the median within-species nearest-type distance of this corpus — nearer than two types of one bird usually are. A distance, not a claim of borrowing or kinship.

retention.rule: each species keeps its 8 nearest partners; the union, deduplicated. Every query the app makes (a species' three nearest) is answered exactly as the complete document would answer it.
retention.note: sharedTypesKept counts only the kept pairs and is NOT this corpus's shared-type total — sharedTypesComputed is. The complete document is what compute_relations returns and what the build reports its statistics from; this file is the browser's copy of the part it reads.
